nodes.label: The handbook prohibits highway driving with cannabis concentration at least five nanograms per milliliter of whole blood or ten nanograms per milliliter of another bodily substance.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning cannabis threshold depends on tested substance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning authorized cannabis does not authorize impaired driving; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning cannabis transport has container conditions; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Neither the driver nor a passenger may use cannabis inside a motor vehicle.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning no cannabis consumption in vehicle; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: When an officer reasonably suspects cannabis impairment during a stop, the driver must submit to field-sobriety testing, validated roadside chemical testing or both.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning reasonable suspicion can require cannabis testing; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Refusing the stated cannabis tests or failing field-sobriety or validated roadside chemical testing leads to license suspension under the handbook’s rule.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning cannabis testing refusal or failure affects license; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning cannabis offense can affect driving and patient card; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning legal medicine may still impair driving; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning alcohol and drugs can be dangerous together; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An Illinois driving-under-the-influence conviction remains permanently on the driving record, and arrest or conviction can result in lost driving privileges, registration consequences, fines or imprisonment.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning dui has enduring record consequences; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning serious crash and probable cause require test request; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning additional chosen testing is self-funded; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning chemical-test refusal has longer ordinary suspension; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning recent qualifying history changes summary penalty; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning repeat refusal differs from repeat failure; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning refusal can become evidence; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning general revocation minimums increase with convictions; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning fourth conviction has lifetime consequence; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning high concentration or young passenger can enhance penalties; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.
